question: What supreme form encompasses all deities as the goddess of speech?
premises: Vāgdevī is the goddess of speech.
All deities are included in her.
She has the form of the syllable ai and is supreme.
inference: The supreme goddess of speech, in the form of the syllable ai, encompasses all deities.
plain_english: The goddess of speech, supreme and of the form of the syllable ai, is all the deities.
